description: Derived data for an audited CARE-to-Compare SCADA benchmark is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Siyu Cai. Per-seed and seed-averaged benchmark tables, model summaries, compact diagnostics, publication figures, and public acceptance manifests. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
